subject: DPA annex: PII pathing map, SSQ answers & procurement gating checklist
messages:
From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@healthlink.com>
To: kimberly.park@redwood.com
Cc: isaac.gomez@healthlink.com, procurement@healthlink.com
Date: Mon, 14 Jul 2025 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: DPA annex / SSQ - downstream PII paths and onboarding gating

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks for the quick demo last week. As we discussed with the security team, two asks before we can move the procurement request to legal: 1) a DPA annex draft that explicitly lists subprocessors and transfer paths for PII (particularly for embeddings/telemetry), and 2) the completed security questionnaire focused on data classification, access controls, and a simple dataflow diagram we can include in our onboarding packet.

Could you please:
- Attach a DPA annex draft we can review with our legal counsel (call out which subprocessors handle telemetry vs. model inference)
- Provide a one-page PII pathing map we can share with InfoSec (high-level is fine)
- Complete the SSQ tab for access controls and logging retention so our compliance team can mark the item green

We have a procurement gating checklist that will open the DocuSign once those three items are attached. If you need a point of contact for technical verification, cc Isaac (copied).

Ideal timeline: responses by EOD Monday (7/21) so we can finalize the SOW and PO.

Thanks,
Elena Ruiz
Privacy & Security Lead
HealthLink Medical

Attachments: none in this initial message

From: kimberly.park@redwood.com <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@healthlink.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, jordan.blake@redwood.com, isaac.gomez@healthlink.com
Date: Mon, 14 Jul 2025 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: DPA annex / SSQ - downstream PII paths and onboarding gating

Elena,

Appreciate the clear asks — we'll take these in parallel. Quick plan and owners:
- DPA annex draft (including subprocessor table + transfer notes): Marissa will send a first pass by Wed 7/16.
- PII pathing map (one-page PDF showing ingress, prefix caching, inference, telemetry export): I'll attach v1 and include a short legend for the legal/infosec team.
- SSQ answers (access controls / retention): Jordan will populate the access & logging tab and return a reviewed XLSX by Mon 7/21.

We have one item to flag: HealthLink asked previously whether onshore-only processing for certain PHI fields is a hard requirement or a preference. If it's an absolute requirement we need to swap to a dedicated region/pool (this affects cost and the timing of the PO). Can you confirm whether onshore residency for core inference is required or if hybrid (in-region compute + encrypted egress to onshore auditors) is acceptable?

I'll attach the DPA annex draft and the PII pathing map now for your intake. Marissa and Jordan are copied for detailed SSQ commentary.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Head of Enterprise Security Sales, Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0132

Attachments:
- redwood_dpa_annex_v2.docx (DPA annex draft; redlines welcome)
- pii_pathing_map_v1.pdf (one-page pathing map; see legend on page 1)

From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@healthlink.com>
To: kimberly.park@redwood.com
Cc: isaac.gomez@healthlink.com, procurement@healthlink.com
Date: Wed, 16 Jul 2025 09:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: DPA annex / SSQ - downstream PII paths and onboarding gating

Kimberly, thanks — received the annex draft and the map. High-level feedback from our InfoSec:
- The PII pathing map is helpful but please annotate which subprocessors persist telemetry for >24 hours vs ephemeral caching only.
- We need explicit language in the annex about KMS custody and whether keys are customer-separable (they prefer a KMS enclave reference rather than generic KMS language).
- Onshore requirement: For the initial pilot, we can accept hybrid as long as the inference for PII-tagged records for US patients stays within US regions. We will require a line item in the SOW for region-lock options if we scale.

Procurement is ready to open DocuSign once Jordan's SSQ tab and a short summary of subprocessor persistence windows are in place. Attaching the SSQ template back with inline comments for the access controls section — Josh in our procurement team added a couple of schedule items.

Thanks,
Elena

Attachments: ssq_answers_healthlink.xlsx (commented template from HealthLink procurement)

From: marissa.cole@redwood.com <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@healthlink.com>, kimberly.park@redwood.com
Cc: jordan.blake@redwood.com, isaac.gomez@healthlink.com, procurement@healthlink.com
Date: Mon, 21 Jul 2025 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: DPA annex / SSQ - downstream PII paths and onboarding gating

Elena / team,

Thanks for the comments — please find attached the updated artifacts:
- redwood_dpa_annex_v2.docx (updated: added explicit KMS custody language, subprocessor table now includes a "persistence_window" column)
- pii_pathing_map_v1.pdf (annotated: red boxes show components that persist telemetry >24h; blue for ephemeral caches)
- ssq_answers_healthlink.xlsx (completed access controls & logging tab; Jordan validated RBAC roles and the audit log retention policy)

Key clarifications:
- KMS: We support customer KMS key-wrapping via our BYOK integration. The annex now includes two options (managed key with split custody + BYOK with customer key ownership).
- Subprocessors: we list inference runtime providers, telemetry stores, and analytics partners separately; the persistence_window column is "ephemeral (minutes)" or "persistent (days)".
- Residency: we've noted the pilot hybrid allowance and added a line-item reference for regional-only deployments (cost estimate attached as a comment in the DocuSign SOW template).

Next steps: if procurement confirms the DocuSign link, we can start the SOW/PO flow. Happy to hop on a 20-min call if you want to walk through any of the annex language.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Principal, Privacy & Compliance, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 (650) 555-0227

Attachments:
- redwood_dpa_annex_v2.docx (updated with KMS custody + persistence_window column)
- pii_pathing_map_v1.pdf (annotated for persistence)
- ssq_answers_healthlink.xlsx (completed access controls + logging tab)
